description: This file defines the SettingsController class responsible for managing user settings such as streaming quality and subtitles default. It uses a SimpleCache service for persistence and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: SettingsController
classes.description: A controller class that manages user profile settings, including loading, updating, and persisting preferences such as streaming quality and subtitles default options. It extends ChangeNotifier to enable reactive UI updates.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads user settings from cache, updates internal state, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setQuality
methods.description: Sets the preferred streaming quality, saves it to cache, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setSubtitlesDefault
methods.description: Sets the default subtitle preference, saves it to cache, and notifies listeners.
